title: Inventory
subtitle: Track stock, log restocks and waste, and mark dishes sold out.

accessDenied.title: No inventory access
accessDenied.reason: Only owners, admins and managers can manage stock at {branch}.

loadFailed: Part of this page couldn’t be loaded, so some of it may be empty or out of date. Refresh the page to try again.
liveOff: Live updates are paused. Counts may be out of date until the connection comes back.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.permissionDenied: You don’t have permission to change this.
errors.invalidValue: That value isn’t valid. Check it and try again.
errors.notFound: That dish no longer exists at this branch. Refresh the page.
errors.wholeQuantity: Enter a whole number greater than 0.
errors.wholeCount: Enter a whole number: 0 or more.
errors.costInvalid: Enter a cost of 0 or more, or leave it blank.

tracking.notSaved: Nothing was saved for “{name}”. It may have been deleted, or your role may not be allowed to edit the menu at this branch.
tracking.off: Stock tracking is off for “{name}”. It is no longer counted, and ticking the box again asks for a new count.
tracking.onEmpty: Tracking stock for “{name}”, but it has 0 in stock, so customers see it as sold out right away. Log a restock to put it back on sale.

soldOutFailed: Couldn’t change whether “{name}” is sold out. {reason}
thresholdFailed: Couldn’t change the alert level for “{name}”. {reason}

alerts.soldOutHint: Customers and the till can’t order these right now.

status.hiddenHint: Not on the customer menu, so it is left out of the totals and alerts.

markSoldOutConfirm.title: Mark “{name}” sold out?
markSoldOutConfirm.body: Customers and the till can’t order it until midnight (branch time), or until you put it back on sale or restock it.

notices.nowSoldOut: None are left, so customers see it as sold out.
notices.backOnSaleEmpty: “{name}” is no longer marked sold out, but it has none in stock, so it stays sold out until you restock it.

restockDialog.title: Restock {name}
restockDialog.clears86: It is marked sold out until {time}. Restocking puts it back on sale.

countDialog.title: Count {name}
countDialog.hint: Replaces the current count ({count}). Use it after a stock-take.
countDialog.startHint: How many are there right now? Customers can order it until the count reaches 0.
countDialog.clears86: A count above 0 also puts the dish back on sale if it was marked sold out.
